title: Putnami Workload Qualification Verdict
description: The single outcome of running a workload's smoke contract against one target. It fails closed: passed is the only pass, and a passed verdict carries its proof — every phase passed, at least one request and every request passed, the observed build matching the expected one, and a clean teardown.

protocolVersion.description: Document version. A reader refuses any other value.

project.description: Canonical ID of the qualified workload.

kind.description: local is a workload composed on this machine; url is a running deployment.

url.description: Base URL requests were sent to. Required for a url target; never carries credentials.

compositionId.description: Identifier of the local composition that served the target.

binding.description: Which build the verdict proves. A tree binding names the worktree fingerprint and HEAD; an artifact binding names the sha the deployment must report.

kind.description: tree for a local target, artifact for a deployed one.

fingerprint.description: Content digest of the worktree a tree binding served.

dirty.description: Whether that worktree differed from HEAD.

expectedSHA.description: Git sha an artifact binding requires the target to report on /version (prefix match, at least 7 characters).

observedSHA.description: Sha the target reported on /version, when it reported one.

version.description: Version the target reported on /version, when it reported one.

requests.description: Number of requests the contract holds.

derivedFrom.description: Documents the executed contract was derived from.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the document read.

digest.description: Digest the source document declares for itself.

phases.description: Every phase, in execution order: resolve-target, readiness, version-binding, smoke, teardown. A phase that never started is not_run.

diagnostics.description: Findings explaining a non-pass state. They carry no secret.

code.description: Stable qualify.* code a consumer branches on.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; not a frozen vocabulary.

field.description: Dotted member path the finding is about, when it is about one.

requests.description: Every contract request, in contract order. A request that never ran is not_run.

status.description: HTTP status the target answered, when it answered.

state.description: The verdict: the first non-pass phase state, or passed. Only passed is a pass; exit code 0 follows it alone.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the run started.

finishedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the run finished.

cleanup.description: Teardown report of a local target; absent for a url target.

state.description: clean released everything; partial left resources behind.

leftovers.description: Resources a partial teardown left behind.

state.description: Closed outcome vocabulary. passed is the only pass.
